title: Python 1 — Printing and variables
intro: Your first Python program, straight in the browser.

blocks.html:
What we are doing today

Python is a language for telling a computer what to do.

Today you will write your own program and make it say your name.

  • Everything runs in this page - nothing to install
  • Press Run to see what your code does

blocks.prompt: What did the computer do when you pressed Run?

blocks.title: Ask for a name
blocks.starter:
name = input("What is your name? ")
print("Hello " + name)

options: Sends the code to a printer
questions.hint: Think about where the words appeared.

blocks.html:
Drawing with code

The turtle draws lines as it moves. Try changing the numbers.

blocks.title: Draw a square
blocks.starter:
import turtle
t = turtle.Turtle()
for side in range(4):
    t.forward(100)
    t.right(90)

blocks.task: Take a screenshot of your finished drawing.
